# Marketing Agent OS

> Marketing Agent OS is an open-source, cross-platform collection of 243 governed AI agent skills for marketing, SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), content, CRO, paid media, lifecycle, social, analytics, growth, sales, and RevOps.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS
License: Apache-2.0 for the wrapper and local additions; each derived skill keeps its source license (MIT or Apache-2.0) in its folder.
Current version: 2.2.0
Last package verification: 2026-11-01; historical native-host checks are dated in the compatibility matrix.

## Installation

Interactive ecosystem install:

    npx skills add iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS

Clone and install:

    git clone https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS.git
    cd Marketing-Agent-OS
    ./install.sh --agent universal --scope project --project /path/to/project

Windows PowerShell:

    .\install.ps1 -Agent universal -Scope project -Project C:\path\to\project

## Key facts

- 243 unique Agent Skills, 222 of them carrying complete upstream instructions.
- 14 direct installer targets.
- Linux, macOS, and Windows support.
- Agent Skills CLI 1.5.22 discovered all 243 skills and projected a selected skill across 76 registered agent definitions.
- OpenCode 1.18.15 discovered the package from native and universal paths.
- Four complete upstream snapshots are pinned by commit and tree hash.
- The marketing-os skill includes four complete, offline source archives.
- Instructions need no runtime; optional bundled helpers use Python 3 or Node.js, and some need optional packages.
